crossStreamContributions.implementedBehavior: One SQL snapshot separates known conflict failures from explicit uncertainty. It reads existing active Shared PriceCommand, exact frozen Listing/Internal Variant scope and accepted pre-action versus current effective price/currency/promotion/sellability/positive-zero availability. The same failure reader guards actual final seal, API/manual reservation, public command creation and final APPLY; Preview displays both arrays, and Human final approval consumes exact action blockers.
crossStreamContributions.positiveBoundary: Known nonoverlapping/foreign-organization scopes and terminal Shared commands are not permanent locks. Unexecuted approved price recommendations are not interventions. Unknown contexts stay UNRESOLVED, not ISOLATED, without inventing material change. Descriptive native status/content completeness do not invent thresholds.
crossStreamContributions.negativeBoundary: Actual SQL attempted seal/reservation/creator/APPLY and actual Manual planner/lifecycle reject known intervening PriceCommand. Five known-to-known context factors are independent; missing one cannot hide a different changed factor. Accepted-time checks prevent future/late accepted facts rewriting prior knowledge.
proofLimits: R21 executed all 21 CrossDomain invocations and all 15 Manual invocations with zero failure/error/skip, including both Manual isolation methods. This proves the named actual sinks on the archived R21 source. The whole 289-node batch still had one unrelated missing-Bundle reason assertion failure; later source changes and final clean/full/CI are not proven by these local passes.
Price fixtures use real Shared schema/binding, eight family economics and watermarks plus synthetic approved authority; they are not an actual Price human UI or Provider execution.
The APPLY test invokes actual open_ad_bid_command_attempt after a previously empty real gate, with a synthetic worker state. It is not a second end-to-end worker success journey.
No Shared Price writer lock is added. Final gate rereads committed known changes, with no claim of fully serialized cross-domain writers.
No scheduled Listing/promotion intervention registry exists or is invented from Task labels; known accepted comparable facts are used.

crossStreamContributions.rootCause: The original SQL matrices seeded worker phases and reused a fixed fence. Real worker R20 demonstrated two additional production failures: deferObservation cleared the accepted native-task lease but PLATFORM_PENDING was constrained to always hold one; and a governed retry acquired a new fence then attempted APPLY using the preceding fence readback, correctly failing strict retry proof. The earlier known-task STATUS timeout orchestration also discarded its addressable observation path.
crossStreamContributions.implementedBehavior: Only inconclusive STATUS_ENQUIRY for an accepted addressable native Task defers another read-only poll. Idle PLATFORM_PENDING may have no lease, but every transport open/complete still checks the active lease and fence, and defer cannot release an IN_FLIGHT attempt. A RETRY_WAIT lease alone sets private retry_preflight_fence to its incremented fence; the worker must READBACK under this new lease. Only fresh MATCHES_PRIOR plus the unchanged strict retry proof, budget, delay and live gate can enter EXECUTING; that transition consumes the marker. New-fence target completes without APPLY, third value investigates, unreadable becomes Unknown. Marker clears on released/terminal phases; an expired retry preflight becomes Unknown while an expired first-apply lease returns Pending.
proofLimits: R20 executed the old four worker scenarios: two negative paths passed and both positive retry paths failed at actual lease/fence boundaries. R21 then executed all nine current scenarios with zero failure/error/skip, including the same two previously failing positive methods and the new-fence/readback/recovery controls. This establishes the scoped repair on the archived R21 source, not a final clean/CI verdict or an overall passing R21 batch.

Protocol bytes, fictional transport registry and initial approved control graph are synthetic. Actual command creation, Java worker transitions, leases, durable attempts, Raw custody, frozen classification and readback/retry gates are production implementations; no f.state is used to advance these worker scenarios.
The two lease-recovery tests explicitly inject only lease_expires_at using the migration fixture after an actual lease; they prove actual recovery routing, not a real process crash or network outage.
Resolved SUCCESS plus prior supports the existing safe native-idempotent reentry rule; it does not prove the earlier APPLY never occurred.

Fine-grained stale approval, native unit, credential, gate-envelope and adversarial completion matrices remain separately bound to actual SQL RetryProofIT/MinimumExpiryIT/ActorRevocationIT. These nine tests supplement, not replace, those matrix proofs.
production_write_enabled=false and fictional-only commands/Raw evidence are asserted; no Provider network, real account or production transport is covered.

namedAssertionBoundaries.specificAssertion: Actual accepted native Task survives a status timeout as idle read-only PLATFORM_PENDING; the same native Task is polled again, conclusive SUCCESS plus independent prior permits governed same-key reentry only after a fresh new-fence prior readback. Idle status opening without lease must fail MO090.

Frozen exact NOT_APPLIED bytes are classified by actual repository/DB; prior readback first enters RETRY_WAIT. The retried APPLY retains command/key/target/object and shares the new-fence readback fence, strictly newer than the first prior proof.
An APPLY timeout lacking native idempotency/task remains Unknown; an explicitly requested actual readback at prior cannot authorize a retry or invent a status identity.
A third value after NOT_APPLIED enters investigation and never performs a second APPLY.
Even when the earlier lease proved prior and entered RETRY_WAIT, a third value at the new retry fence enters investigation; old proof cannot authorize APPLY and marker is cleared.

Actual governed retry lease sets marker and invalidates old-fence proof; direct transition to EXECUTING is MO092 and app marker UPDATE is 42501. Injected lease expiry then actual repository recovery yields Unknown with marker cleared, and write lease is MO091.
An exact target at the fresh retry fence completes READBACK_MATCHED with no second APPLY and clears marker.
An unreadable fresh retry readback yields Unknown with no second APPLY, old proof false and marker cleared.
An ordinary first-apply lease gets no retry marker; injected lease expiry and actual recovery return Pending with zero attempts. Test then uses an existing terminal no-send transition for cleanup.
